meta.description: Shared, deduplicated founder failure page. Link as settings.errorWorkflow from money ticks (release-job, reconciliation, payment-sweeper, payout-failure-alert) and the database backup workflow. Metadata-only — never forwards payment references, tokens, PII, or Supabase service-role keys. Dedupe collapses repeated identical failures (workflow|status|lastNode) to one page per ALERT_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES (default 15). STATUS: active:false — founder-gated activation only.
